description: Regression fixture for scanner using 5 test stocks (NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, QQQ, SPY). This dataset exercises all four pipeline stages and should produce exactly the expected funnel counts and candidate output.

stage2.note: All symbols pass liquidity screen: sufficient bars, dollar volume, price floor, freshness

stage3.note: 3 dropped by trend filters (MA alignment, slope). 2 survivors proceed to setup detection.

score_range.note: Score must be deterministic but allow ±0.5 for floating point variation

regeneration_procedure.step_1: Obtain real market data for ~200 liquid symbols on known date
regeneration_procedure.step_2: Run scanner.scan() with frozen time (freezegun) on that date
regeneration_procedure.step_3: Record stage entry/exit counts and per-stage drop reasons
regeneration_procedure.step_4: Record final candidate list with symbol, setup, score, score_breakdown
regeneration_procedure.step_5: Update strategy_version in this comment if weights or indicators changed
regeneration_procedure.step_6: Save bars data as CSV in this directory for future regression tests
regeneration_procedure.step_8: Commit the fixture and test together with rationale in commit message

notes: This is the MVP fixture using 5 seeded test stocks. In production, create fixture with ~200 symbols covering breakout, pullback, consolidation, and momentum setups, plus edge cases (low liquidity, recent IPO, high volatility, data gap).
